text:
Hello — I'm **Mara**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus my own Messenger and Instagram — each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours; you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts**: I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Status: staff meeting moved to the week of Nov 30 - Dec 4, 30-minute slot. Priya, Mara and Diego are in on four candidate times (Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30); only Sarah and John haven't sent their windows yet. Booking and logging as soon as they do.

Done, with one change you should know about.

The staff meeting could not be placed in the coming week: Mara's only free window (Thu 13:00-14:00) is taken for me and the other four TAs, and none of them could make Tue 11:00 or Wednesday. So, with all five TAs agreeing, I moved it to the following week:

**CSE455 staff meeting — Tue Dec 1, 15:00-15:30** (staff sync plus the grading hand-off), confirmed by Mara, Sarah, John, Priya and Diego.

Calendar: added to Tuesday of the week of Nov 30 - Dec 4; logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday Dec 1 15:00-15:30 with Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego`, plus a note on why the coming week didn't work. Nothing else moved: teaching, office hours, seminars and committees were never on the table, and the 30 minutes comes out of free time. I checked the week's official schedule with the department office first (nothing cancelled or moved).

Two open caveats: Sarah and Priya said their own recurring commitments aren't on their calendars yet and will tell me if one lands on the slot; and anything the 30 minutes can't hold goes round in writing after.
